test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In 2017, Deepika Reddy got the Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards 2017 for her contribution in the field of _______ dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deepika Reddy** is an **acclaimed Kuchipudi dancer.**
 
• She** started her journey 50 years ago** and she had her Rangapravesham in 1976.
 
• She has performed across the world, including at **the Rashtrapati Bhavan, Sri Lankan parliament, Hiroshima in Japan, and France.**
 
• She received the prestigious **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for her contribution to the Kuchipudi dance** from President **Ram Nath Kovind at Rashtrapati Bhavan.**
 
• Deepika Reddy has been in the **field of Kuchipudi for the past 47 years.**
 
• She has relentlessly propagated this art form through her performances the world over and by training hundreds of students in her dance institute **Deepanjali.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sujata Mohapatra** is a **p****opular Odissi dancer.**
 
• She has mesmerized many people with her graceful moves and she was conferred with the prestigious **Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards for 2017.**
 
• She is a **disciple and daughter-in-law of legendary Odissi guru Kelucharan Mohapatra**.
 
• She is known for her strict adherence to the technicalities of the dance form and genuine expressions that leave the audience spell-bound.
 
• The award carries with it **Rs 100,000, a ‘Tamra Patra’ and an ‘angavastram’.**

**Bharatanatyam**

 
• **Rama Vaidyanathan **is a popular **Bharatanatyam dancer.**
 
• She is one of the** directors of Ganesha Natyalaya**, one of** the best Bharatanatyam institutes in the country.**
 
• She has toured the country and the world, performing and showcasing her art.
 
• She was selected for **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for the year 2017.**

**Manipuri**

 
• L.N. Oinam Ongbi Dhoni Devi is a popular Manipuri dancer.
 
• **​**President Ram Nath Kovind confers** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2017 on Manipuri dancer L.N. Oinam Ongbi Dhoni Devi **during a special investiture ceremony at Rashtrapati Bhawan.
